Class DbOpsBase

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.products.DbOpsBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
DbOps
public class DbOpsBase extends Object implements DbOps
Implementation of DbOps that implements performPreInsertOps() to clear/initialize the various SsComponents on a screen before the user edits the new record. Implements the performPost*Ops methods to use metadata to decide whether or not to re-execute the RowSset command; handles state for the allow* methods.

DbOps is associated with a RowsModel/RowSet, see RowsModel(RowSet, DbOps). performPreInsertOps() searches the container provided to the constructor to find the SsComponents to clean.

    • allowUpdate

      public boolean allowUpdate()
      This functions is called just before doing something that is sensitive to a row being dirty. When it returns true, it is followed by rowSet.updateRow(). Note that the default for AutoCommit is false. So the behavior of SsDataNavigator in conjunction with RowsAction is that when the current row is dirty only commit and undo are enabled.
      Specified by:
      allowUpdate in interface DbOps
      Returns:
      true is the row can be updated else false.

    • cleanComponents

      protected void cleanComponents(Container container)
      In the specified container, clear/initialize SsComponents. Typically done for a new record/row. Uses SsUtils.visitSsComponents(Container, Consumer) to run SsComponent.cleanField().

      This is done for all SwingSet components, for example text fields, and text areas, recursively looking in to the JTabbedPanes and JPanels inside the given container as needed.

      Parameters:
      container - container in which to recursively initialize components
